note: Medicine Bow NF campground among aspen and burned conifer near North and South French Creeks, west of the Snowy Range, reached from Riverside by WY-230 and County Road 660. In the 2020 Mullen Fire burn area. The Lower Tie Hack trailhead is a quarter mile east. --Claude
